instructions: Complete the form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
stem_block:
QUARRY FIELDS LEISURE CENTRE - MEMBERSHIP FORM

Personal details
Surname: (1) ........
Address: flat (2) ........, Pennyfield Court, Pennyfield Road

Membership
Type chosen: full membership
Cost: £(3) ........ a month
(off-peak membership: weekdays only, ends at (4) ........ p.m.)
Payment: direct debit, taken on the (5) ........ of each month
To cancel: no minimum contract - just tell the centre in (6) ........

Before using the gym
Induction with an instructor: lasts roughly (7) ........ minutes
What to bring: a towel, plus indoor (8) ........

Other information
Classes: bookings are no longer taken over the (9) ........
Climbing wall: shut until the end of (10) ........

items.explanation: The surname is spelled out letter by letter in the audio: K-I-R-K-E-G-A-A-R-D. It can only be asked because it is spelled out, as the spelling is hard to guess.

items.prompt: Address: flat (2) ........, Pennyfield Court, Pennyfield Road
items.evidence: It's flat nine, Pennyfield Court, and that's on Pennyfield Road.
items.explanation: The customer first says flat two, then immediately corrects it: that was their old address; the new address is flat nine.

items.evidence: The full one is thirty-eight pounds a month and gets you in whenever we're open.
items.explanation: Full membership is thirty-eight pounds a month; the twenty-six-pound option is the off-peak membership, which the customer is not taking.

items.prompt: (off-peak membership: weekdays only, ends at (4) ........ p.m.)
items.evidence: It was five until the spring, but it's four now.
items.explanation: The poster outside says five, but the adviser says the poster is out of date: off-peak membership now ends at four o'clock.

items.prompt: Payment: direct debit, taken on the (5) ........ of each month
items.evidence: It comes out by direct debit on the first of the month.
items.explanation: Payment is taken on the first of the month; the fifteenth was the old arrangement, and everyone was switched to the first in January.

items.prompt: To cancel: no minimum contract - just tell the centre in (6) ........
items.evidence: you just give us a month's notice in writing if you want to stop
items.explanation: The minimum contract period has been removed; a month's notice in writing is now all that is needed to stop the membership.

yeniden_uretim.kaynak: sizinti yazim turu - dinleme L3 (kardes ajan gorevi)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: To cancel: inform the centre in (6) ........, one month beforehand
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: you just give us a month's notice in writing if you want to stop
yeniden_uretim.neden_isaretlendi: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: 'merkeze bir ay önceden (6) bildirin' çerçevesi 'inform in writing' eşdiziminin ucunu açık bırakıyor, kalıbın kendisi cevabı söylüyor.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Cerceve 'inform the centre in (6) ........, one month beforehand' idi: 'notice ... in' esdiziminin ucu acik kaliyordu ve 'one month beforehand' zaten yazili oldugu icin boslugu doldurabilecek tek dogal sozcuk 'writing' kaliyordu. Yeni cercevede hem 'notice' sozcugu hem de sure bilgisi cikarildi; 'tell the centre in ........' boslugu 'advance', 'person' ve 'writing' arasinda aciliyor. Sessiz sinamada 'let the centre know in ...' bicimi 3/3, 'tell the centre in ...' bicimi 2/3 verdigi icin ikincisi secildi. NOT: 'writing' sozcugunun kendisi hala genel bilgiyle tahmin edilebiliyor; kalan sizinti cerceve kusuru degil genel_kultur ve boslugun sesteki baska bir degere tasinmasini, yani senaryo isini gerektiriyor.

items.prompt: Induction with an instructor: lasts roughly (7) ........ minutes
items.explanation: The customer was told an hour, but since the fitness assessment is now a separate appointment, the induction tour now takes forty minutes.

items.prompt: What to bring: a towel, plus indoor (8) ........
items.evidence: Bring a towel and a pair of indoor trainers
items.explanation: Because the studio floor has been redone, outdoor shoes are not allowed in; along with a towel, indoor trainers are required.

items.prompt: Classes: bookings are no longer taken over the (9) ........
items.evidence: we stopped taking bookings over the telephone
items.explanation: Class bookings are all made through the website or the app; the centre stopped taking bookings over the telephone.

yeniden_uretim.kaynak: sizinti yazim turu - dinleme L3 (kardes ajan gorevi)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Classes: booked online or through the app - not by (9) ........
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: we stopped taking bookings over the telephone
yeniden_uretim.neden_isaretlendi: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: 'internetten ya da uygulamadan — (9) ile değil' çerçevesi iki kanalı sayıp üçüncüyü dışlıyor ve dışlanabilecek tek kanal telefon.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Cerceve 'booked online or through the app - not by (9) ........' idi: iki kanali sayip ucuncuyu disliyordu, yani karsitligi cerceve kuruyordu ve dislanabilecek tek kanal kaliyordu. Kanal listesi cerceveden tumuyle cikarildi - karsitlik artik yalniz seste ('It's all done through the website or the app; we stopped taking bookings over the telephone'). Bosluk sesteki 'over the ...' kalibina acildi; bu kalipta 'counter' en az 'telephone' kadar dogal, dolayisiyla cerceve tek adayi ayakta birakmiyor. NOT: sessiz sinamada uc turda da 'phone' yazildi. Kanal listesi cerceveden cikarildigi icin isaretlenen cerceve_sozu kusuru kapandi, ama 'rezervasyon artik su yolla alinmiyor' cumlesinin kendisi dunya bilgisiyle telefonu isaret ediyor; kalan sizinti genel_kultur ve boslugun sesteki baska bir degere tasinmasini, yani senaryo isini gerektiriyor. Bu turda duzeltilmedi, raporlandi.

items.prompt: Climbing wall: shut until the end of (10) ........
items.evidence: That reopens at the end of April.
items.explanation: The climbing wall is closed because its holds are being replaced; it reopens at the end of April.
